description: What is the Kp index right now? Returns the current planetary Kp (0-9), its storm level (G1-G5 if any) and the 3-hourly values for the last 24 hours (or up to 7 days), from NOAA SWPC. Useful for aurora chasers, radio amateurs and anyone asking whether a geomagnetic storm is under way. It reports observed activity only; use kp_forecast_3day for the coming days. (cost: 1 credit)

hours.description: integer, optional, how many hours of 3-hourly history to include ending at the latest reading (3-168), default 24

name: kp_index_now
